verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Runloop publishes its own MCP server so external agents can call Runloop's tools (runloop-probe-4), but there is no evidence that Runloop itself can act as an MCP client and plug in third-party MCP servers to use their tools. missing for 10: any documentation of an MCP-client integration point, config for adding external MCP servers, or examples of Devboxes/agents consuming external MCP tool servers.
